notes.title: Economy Overview - What Sets Lootimals Apart
notes.notes: [p][b]Lootimals Economy Overview[/b][/p][p]In [b]Lootimals[/b], the core of the collection and exchange system is built around [b]Lootimal Tickets[/b]. These tickets act as a central mechanic for managing pets in the game. Within the in-game [b]Laboratory[/b], players can trade pets for tickets and exchange tickets to receive new pets. Visit the Laboratory in game to view the pet to ticket exchange ratios.[/p][p][/p][p]Lootimal Tickets allow players to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Exchange[/b] for pets from specific rarity tiers at set ticket exchange rates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bypass[/b] the 30-minute drop timer to instantly hatch a random pet.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640673/c4c8c8675173f0d7c81147a8683e979620a76d28.png"][/img][/p][h3]How the System Works[/h3][p]Lootimal Tickets connect all parts of the pet ecosystem. Rather than following a rigid model like “trade 10 commons for 1 uncommon,” this system allows for more flexible, transparent, and engaging progression.[/p][p]Benefits of this structure include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Balanced rarity availability[/b] – Rare pets remain meaningful without being impossibly hard to obtain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consistent gameplay rhythm[/b] – 30-minute drop intervals keep engagement high.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clear, pegged exchange rates[/b] – Makes it easy for players to understand value and identify fair trades.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Natural market flow[/b] – The system allows player behavior to shape supply and demand in a healthy, visible way.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players can use their tickets whenever they choose, offering full control over when to hatch new pets, respond to collection needs, or take advantage of market trends.[/p][p][/p][p]New updates and content are already in development with a focus on bringing fun and entertainment to the Lootimals community![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Lootimals is Here — Start Hatching Today! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to [b]Lootimals[/b], the ultimate idle pet collection game where every 30 minutes brings you a brand-new surprise egg! Whether you're chasing down your final Legendary Cuburtle or filling out your growing Moolox lineup, there's always a new Lootimal waiting to join your collection.[/p][p]🐣 [b]How It Works:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🎁 [b]Drops Every 30 Minutes[/b] – Hatch new Lootimals as you play or even while minimized![/p][/*][*][p]🐾 [b]Randomized Hatching[/b] – Every egg holds a Lootimal with its own name, style, and rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Rarity Tiers[/b] – From common critters to ultra-rare Legendaries, the thrill of the hunt never ends.[/p][/*][*][p]🏅 [b]Achievements & Full Collection Tracker[/b] – Perfect for completionists![/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Unlock Egg Skins & Backgrounds[/b] – Customize your experience while you collect.[/p][/*][*][p]🔄 [b]Convert Extras Into Tickets[/b] – Trade duplicates for more chances to hatch what you're missing.[/p][/*][/list][p]💰 [b]Plus: Buy, Sell, and Trade on the Steam Community Market![/b]
Collected pets can be bought and sold directly through the [b]Steam Community Market[/b], allowing players to trade for their missing Lootimals or turn duplicates into Steam Wallet funds![/p][p]🎯 No battles. No pay-to-win. Just chill, collect, and complete your perfect pet collection at your own pace.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🗓 [b]Lootimals is available now — jump in, start hatching, and build your dream collection![/b][/p][p]✅ [b]Don’t forget to leave a review and share your rarest Lootimal drops with the community![/b][/p]
